participants: 明裔军户与实际服役者
实际在场的混合家庭与宗教团体

desc.zh: 六个月是资格、实际岗位与地方执行均连续满足后才可通过的最低观察期；若未达标，等待并补足条件，不把共享投递排队当作失败。十二个月只在选定路线确有条件缺口时提示；三十六月出现有限结算或撤回选择。十个主线事件受共享90日冷却，首个事件之后完整顺序最短约27个月。
desc.en: Six months is the minimum continuous period with eligibility, staffed posts and local execution all in place. If conditions are short, wait and address them; the shared delivery queue is not a failure. The twelve-month notice appears only for a real route-specific shortfall; month thirty-six offers limited settlement or withdrawal. The shared 90-day cooldown means the ten sequential main events take at least about 27 months after the first event.

desc.zh: 首轮承诺后进行九个月审查：资格是否仍合现行法律、职位是否实际在岗、地区申诉是否可用，以及财政和疆域是否变化。按现行分权法判断选举；王权无选举时核查公职和共同任命，不虚构议席。
desc.en: A nine-month review checks whether eligibility still matches law, posts are staffed, local appeals work, and fiscal or territorial facts changed. Use current election law; without elections, review public offices and joint appointments rather than inventing seats.

title.zh: 一张军饷名册上的三种称呼
title.en: Three Names on the Muster Roll

desc.zh: 军饷册里有明裔军户、华商家庭与本地守军。共同纳税服役不自动等于同一任官、从军或申诉资格。无现役军队时改核官署名册；身份群体缺席时改看实际迁入者。
desc.en: The roll lists Ming-descended service households, merchant families and local defenders. Shared taxes and service do not grant the same access to office, military work or appeals. Without an active army, review office rolls; if a group is absent, examine current newcomers.

label.zh: 共同资格
label.en: Set common public qualifications

cost_note.zh: 年总收入÷52，最低100；登记与申诉所的一周费用。
cost_note.en: One estimated week of gross income, minimum 100, funds registry and appeals.

consequence_note.zh: 不改法律、主流文化或政体；任职另核真实岗位。
consequence_note.en: Does not change law, primary culture or government; appointments need real jobs.

label.zh: 地区契约
label.en: Joint tax offices and local appeals

cost_note.zh: 年总收入÷52，最低100；另负担持续地方核验。
cost_note.en: Same registry estimate; local verification continues.

consequence_note.zh: 跨区任官和迁居仍需重谈。
consequence_note.en: Cross-region officeholding and migration remain subject to negotiation.

label.zh: 旧身份
label.en: Keep status rolls and publish limits

cost_note.zh: 登记费外另付一周收入估算，维持分治行政。
cost_note.en: Registry plus a separate one-week estimate for divided administration.

consequence_note.zh: 旧盟友保有地位，新人须单独申诉。
consequence_note.en: Old allies keep their status; newcomers need separate appeals.

purpose.zh: 分别确认资格、地区契约或旧身份路线。
purpose.en: Record common qualifications, a territorial compact, or status orders.

desc.zh: 纳税和服役记录不是已获任命。现行公民法律、非主流人口的实际 acceptance、官署或营房就业分别检查；分开的检查不证明同一群体进入了岗位。
desc.en: Tax and service records are not appointments. Check current citizenship law, actual acceptance among non-primary pops, and administration or barracks staffing separately; separate checks do not prove the same group holds the jobs.

label.en: Pay a one-time transition grant and open competition

cost_note.en: One weekly opening-income estimate, minimum 100; paid once.

consequence_note.zh: 缓冲转制，不直接填军队。
consequence_note.en: Grant cushions transition but does not fill the army.

purpose.zh: 留下旧军户转制与竞任承诺。
purpose.en: Record transition support and competition for military service.

title.zh: 村社不是一个人的签名
title.en: A Village Is More Than One Signature

desc.zh: 地方契约须说明谁能代表村社。混合听证、贵族担保或王命直下各自改变地方执行和申诉；无选举法时只能写听证或公职联署。
desc.en: Choose one appeal institution: each costs a further estimated week of gross income (minimum 100) and changes legitimacy, authority or bureaucracy for 24 months. The later local execution review checks an actually employed secondary-culture worker, staffed and supplied administration, the inheritance rule, the public-language rule and this institution. A crown may use joint hearings without election law.

events.trigger: { c:DMG ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_dmg_public_qualification ywc_dmg_v03_unsettled = yes }

label.en: Fund a mixed hearing and appeal roll

cost_note.zh: 另扣一周估算年总收入（年总收入÷52），最低100。
cost_note.en: One additional week of gross income (yearly gross income / 52), minimum 100.

consequence_note.zh: 共同听审每两年增加文书负担，换取少量正当性。
consequence_note.en: Consultative hearing; costs bureaucracy while it improves legitimacy.

label.zh: 贵族担保，保地方权但范围窄
label.en: Use a noble guarantee with narrow jurisdiction

cost_note.zh: 另扣一周估算年总收入（年总收入÷52），最低100。
cost_note.en: One additional week of gross income (yearly gross income / 52), minimum 100.

consequence_note.zh: 贵族担保每两年占用权威，并提高正当性。
consequence_note.en: Protects local rights, but costs authority while raising legitimacy.

label.zh: 王命直下，承担地方对立
label.en: Issue a royal order and accept local resistance

cost_note.zh: 另扣一周估算年总收入（年总收入÷52），最低100。
cost_note.en: One additional week of gross income (yearly gross income / 52), minimum 100.

consequence_note.zh: 王命每两年降低正当性，保留行政能力。
consequence_note.en: Expands administrative reach while reducing legitimacy.

purpose.zh: 记录谁执行地方契约并提供申诉。
purpose.en: A choice of local appeal institution with a one-week-income cost and a 24-month political or administrative tradeoff.

title.en: Two Heirs With the Same Name

desc.zh: 一个继承个案不能代表所有家庭。统一任官解释、地区分别认定或保留旧例并复核；不自动改写全部财产权。无相应群体时转为迁入者跨地区复议。
desc.en: One inheritance case cannot speak for all households. Choose one office rule, district-by-district recognition, or retain precedent with review; none rewrites all property rights. If the relevant group is absent, review newcomers' cross-district appeals.

purpose.en: Limit what a single case proves about inheritance.

title.zh: 祭礼之后，谁来宣读税令
title.en: Who Reads the Tax Order After the Rite

desc.zh: 宗教仪礼、公共语言和税务申诉相互牵连。共同宣读、礼仪并行或维持宫廷单一仪式都需要真实官署承担翻译和解释。
desc.en: Ritual, public language and tax appeals intersect. Shared readings, parallel rites or one court ritual all require real offices to provide interpretation.

label.en: Read orders jointly and register translation needs

cost_note.zh: 费用不因重复事件重复收取。
cost_note.en: No officials are created; real offices staff translation.

consequence_note.zh: 只结算该项承诺，不自动改变法律或人口。
consequence_note.en: Translation remains the offices' work.

label.zh: 礼仪并行，由地区分别解释
label.en: Allow parallel rites and local explanations

cost_note.zh: 保留已支付费用，继续承担地方核验。
cost_note.en: Districts retain interpretation duties.

consequence_note.zh: 跨区例外和下一代争议继续存在。
consequence_note.en: Retains multiple practices and cross-district costs.

label.en: Keep one court rite and explain each order

cost_note.zh: 保留旧身份行政成本，不重复收费。
cost_note.en: Offices explain orders individually.

consequence_note.zh: 旧资格清楚列明，新人待遇留待申诉。
consequence_note.en: Central rites do not grant newcomers office access.

purpose.zh: 让礼仪和翻译承担真实行政责任。
purpose.en: Tie ritual and translation to actual administration.

desc.zh: 至少六个月的连续路线条件已经满足。共同资格要求完全接纳（第5档），并在同一人口范围确认非主流群体实际受雇为官僚或军人，工作地点是有足够就业且无短缺的行政机构或军营。地方路线另要求次要文化人口实际在有足够就业、无短缺的行政机构工作。事件排队只等待90日门控后的投递窗口，不算改革受阻。十二个月提示只针对真实路线缺口；三十六月提供有限结算或撤回。
desc.en: The minimum six-month continuous readiness period has elapsed. Common eligibility requires full acceptance (tier 5) and the same non-primary group actually employed as bureaucrats or military staff in a staffed, supplied administration or barrack; acceptance and jobs are linked in one pop scope. The local route separately requires an actually employed secondary-culture pop at a staffed administration. Queued results wait for the next 90-day event window and are not failure. A twelve-month notice requires a real route gap; month thirty-six offers limited settlement or withdrawal.
